perspectives.summary: The feature spec, acceptance criteria, tests, and traceability now authorize only target-only GitOps code/manifests/tooling at spec; downstream evidence and activation gates are sequenced explicitly.

The approved storage decisions are recorded: DBs 5Gi local-path RWO, runtimes 1Gi, artifacts 20Gi static NFS RWX Retain, scratch 5Gi temporary/NFS, temporary restore, no new Longhorn, and 70/85% alerts with tested logical migration. NAS and restore proofs remain later gates.

Provider common-cutoff/WAL/artifact SHA evidence is required before restore/migration/cutover; ExternalSecret refs and least-privilege RBAC may be coded without values; fresh credentials/reauthentication are required before enablement. Historical PVCs are forbidden targets.

consensus_summary: PASS spec gate. Proceed to code for target-only GitOps code, manifests, policies, and tooling only. Do not sync Argo, restore, mutate source, activate credentials, enable workloads, inspect/reuse/delete/mutate historical PVCs, or switch local Codex until downstream gates pass.
downstream_gates: Provider common-cutoff/WAL and complete artifact SHA/reference closure before restore, logical migration, or cutover.
NAS ACL/capacity, backup, disposable restore, retention/deletion protection, and logical migration evidence at test/validation/deployment gates.
Fresh target credential material and reauthentication before workload enablement.
Argo sync, restore, source mutation, credential activation, and local Codex switch remain prohibited until their gates pass.
excluded_targets: Historical and retained PVCs: do not inspect, reuse, delete, or mutate.
Codicarium resources, credentials, source provider state, and existing central-connected worker.
